Solution 1 has an arithmetic error. The robot covers 1000 m in 2.5 × 3600 = 9000 s, so its speed is 1000/9000 = 1/9 m/s, not 4/9. This gives 90 × (1/9) = 10 m, so its answer of 40 is wrong.

Solution 2 rounds 1/9 ≈ 0.111 m/s down to 0.1 m/s. This gives 9 m, which is wrong.

Solution 3 uses 2500 m instead of 1000 m for the 1 km trip. This gives 2500/9000 × 90 = 25 m, which is wrong.

The correct length is 10 meters, and none of the solutions reach it.

CHOICE: NONE
